fr.elements: Main Residence; Front Driveway; Front Entry Area; Walkway; Patio Area; Open Lawn Area; Landscaped Area; Dense Vegetation; Street Frontage
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Dense Vegetation; Limited Rear Access; Vegetation Near Structure
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance visible from both directions of travel on the street.
• Trim dense vegetation along the driveway to maintain clear sightlines and unobstructed vehicle passage to the structure.
• Keep a minimum of 10 feet of clearance on both sides of the driveway so emergency vehicles can reach the front entry without obstruction.
• Cut back vegetation growing close to the structure to keep a clear path around the exterior walls for responders moving on foot.
• Mark or unlock any rear gate or access point so responders can locate and use it without delay.
• Clear a walking path along at least one side of the structure connecting the front entry area to the rear of the property.
• Keep the front walkway and patio area free of stored items that could block responder movement to the main entry.
• Thin dense vegetation near the structure so responders can move around the perimeter and see the exterior walls clearly.

wildfire.conditions: Structure Surrounded by Vegetation; Scattered Trees; Scattered Trees; Brush Area; Brush Area; Scattered Shrubs; Grass Cover; Vegetation Near Structure; Tree Cluster; Limited Rear Access; Single Access Route; Open Terrain
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim back shrubs and grass that are growing directly against the house on all sides.
• Thin the scattered trees surrounding the structure to create open gaps between tree canopies and the roofline.
• Remove brush from both identified brush areas nearest to the structure.
• Clear grass cover within the immediate area around the house down to bare soil or very short mowed height.
• Separate the tree cluster from the structure by removing the trees or large shrubs closest to the building within that grouping.
• Thin scattered shrubs near the structure so individual plants are not touching each other or the building.
• Cut back any tree branches that hang over or touch the roof or walls.
• Clear brush and low branches along the single access route so emergency vehicles can move through without obstruction.
• Keep the driveway and access route free of tall grass and encroaching shrubs along both edges.
• Clear vegetation from the rear of the property to open a path for movement and access around the back of the structure.
• Mow or cut grass across the open terrain between the structure and surrounding vegetation to reduce the connection between the two.
• Remove dead grass, dead shrubs, and any dry plant debris piled near or against the structure.
